data.exact_reserve_text: During 2016 the Syndicate released GBP 95.7m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2015: GBP 95.7m), arising predominantly from the Energy and Treaty Divisions (2015: primarily from the Energy, Casualty and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2016.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at the start of 2016 was GBP 1,609.0m. During 2016 the syndicate reported a release of prior year technical reserves of GBP 95.7m (predominantly from the Energy and Treaty divisions) driven by favourable claims development. The release represents approximately a 6.0% reduction relative to opening gross claims outstanding. Specific large losses in 2016 mentioned in the report include cargo losses such as oil assets at the Samir refinery and the Amos 6 satellite loss (Falcon 9 explosion), but the prior year reserve movement was described overall as favourable development rather than being driven by a single quantified event.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities: Claims outstanding) prior-year column. Prior year movement sourced from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which states a release of GBP 95.7m; the note presents the figure in narrative form without explicit labelled 'Insurance liabilities (gross)' column-the figure is treated as a gross movement (confidence 0.8). The gross claims development triangle is present in the notes (page 30) but the scanned image quality limited reliable cell-level extraction of the full development matrix; therefore the triangle presence is noted but detailed development rows not fully transcribed here.
